profile_text.body:
ELLIS, also known as the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe. According to its own site, it is a pan-European AI network of excellence that aims to secure lasting international leadership of AI made in Europe by connecting top researchers in the field and creating a multi-centric AI research laboratory. The organization describes itself as uniting top AI researchers in Europe through Programs, Sites, and a PhD program to advance excellence in machine learning, and as fostering international collaboration across domains while investing in the next generation of AI talent.

The site describes three main structures. The ELLIS PhD and Postdoc Program pairs students with leading researchers across Europe in machine learning, AI and related fields, and offers international exchanges, joint supervision, and a research community. The network of sites across Europe serves as hubs for AI research, and can be composed of local AI research institutions and universities or newly created Institutes. ELLIS Programs focus on advancing AI through theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications such as health and climate, and are led by ELLIS Fellows and Scholars. The site also mentions the Machine Learning Summer School (MLSS), which it says gathered more than 250 students in Tubingen from 31 August to 11 September 2026, and notes that the University of Stuttgart has been a member of the network since 2021. A postdoc position in AI/ML methods for target identification for neuropsychiatric diseases at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) is also listed.

The record held on ELLIS lists no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile classifies it as a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe, with the classification and headquarters taken from the lab's own site.
